messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary error spike for model 'redwood-llm-v2' in eu-west-1. 12% anomalous responses detected, elevated rejection/corrupt-token rates. Paging oncall.
luca-oncall: On it. Joining call in 1m, pulling canary rollout id.
ashley: Observed sample outputs with weird token sequences and stray <UNK> tokens. Some prompt completions are truncated.
ben-ml: Quick checksum: registry artifact redwood-llm-v2:2026-03-16 -> sha256:abc124 expected. Deployed canary nodes report weights sha256:abc123. Possible artifact mismatch during push.
kai-sre: Running node-level check and image labels now.
kai-sre: ```
# on canary node
curl -s http://localhost:9090/metadata | jq .weights_sha
"sha256:abc123"
# compare to artifact registry
gcloud artifacts describe redwood-llm-v2:2026-03-16 --format='value(digest)'
# -> sha256:abc124
```
ashley: tokenizer config also looks off: vocab size mismatch between model and tokenizer package. That would explain the <UNK>s.
devops-jen: I can flip the rollout feature flag to halt the canary. luca, confirm and I'll flip.
luca-oncall: Flip the 'model_rollout_canary' kill switch now for eu-west-1. devops-jen please execute: `./ops/flags set model_rollout_canary eu-west-1 false` and confirm.
devops-jen: Done. Flag flipped -> canaries removed from traffic. Routing fallback to stable model v1.8 initiated. :white_check_mark:
sre-bot: AUTOMATION: Canary teardown triggered by feature-flag. Active canary pods scaled down from 12 -> 0. Traffic routed to stable pool.
ben-ml: Rolling back weights on any remaining canary nodes and scheduling correct artifact redeploy to a fresh canary cluster (sha256:abc124). Preparing hotfix image.
ashley: Customer impact: ~0.6% of requests in eu-west-1 during the window returned malformed tokens or early truncation. No broad latency spike or 5xx surge; a handful of partner integrations reported mismatched outputs. Notifying support to reach out to affected customers.
luca-oncall: Good catch. Ben/jen coordinate redeploy. Kai, validate config sync between tokenizer package and model artifact before any new canary.
kai-sre: Will run a config diff and run smoke tests: tokenization roundtrip and sample prompts. I'll post results when done.
ben-ml: Hotfix image pushed: redwood-llm-v2:2026-03-16-hotfix sha256:abc124. Triggering a small canary of 2 nodes with strict health checks.
ben-ml: Smoke tests passed locally. Tokenizer vocab size matches (50288). Sample prompts produce expected tokens.
kai-sre: Canary smoke on infra: health checks green, tokenization checks pass, sample latency SLO met.
devops-jen: Rolling new canary into eu-west-1 cluster (2 nodes). Monitoring for 10m.
ashley: Support notified customers A/B about possible brief corruption, ETA for fix shared.
luca-oncall: After 10m stable, if metrics look good, we'll resume staged rollout. If any regressions, we abort and rollback to stable v1.8.
ben-ml: 10m window clear. Error rate back to baseline 0.4% on canary traffic, tokenizer errors resolved.
luca-oncall: Resuming rollout to 20% traffic with automatic rollback policy. devops-jen, keep the feature flag gating ready to flip if needed.
devops-jen: Gate ready. I'll watch for alerts and be near keyboard.
sre-bot: AUTOMATION: Rollout resumed -> target 20% traffic. Canary policy in place: abort if error_rate > 2% or tokenization_failures > 0.5%.
ashley: Closing customer impact loop: support ramping communications, customers with anomalies were on older client SDK versions; recommending patch to handle unexpected tokens gracefully while we push out updated models.
luca-oncall: Handing off to eng-sre for postmortem and RCA. Owners: ben-ml (deploy), kai-sre (infra validation), devops-jen (feature flag ops), ashley (customer comms). I'll add this to incidents channel thread and create a follow-up doc. :mag:
ben-ml: Agreed. I'll start a draft RCA with artifact push checklist to prevent mismatched shas and assert tokenizer artifact parity pre-promotion.
ashley: Thanks team. Closing this page for now. If anything else spikes, re-page oncall.
